entities.name: U2N Relay UE Initiation Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the U2N Relay UE when specific conditions are met, including Uu RLF, reception of RRCReconfiguration with reconfigurationWithSync, cell reselection, or various RRC connection failures.

entities.name: Uu Radio Link Failure
entities.description: Condition met upon Uu radio link failure as specified in clause 5.3.10.

entities.name: Reception of RRCReconfiguration with reconfigurationWithSync
entities.description: Condition met when the UE receives an RRCReconfiguration message including the reconfigurationWithSync configuration.

entities.name: RRC Connection Failure
entities.description: Condition met upon L2 U2N Relay UE's RRC connection failure, including RRC connection reject, T300 expiry, and RRC resume failure.

entities.name: T300
entities.description: Timer used in RRC connection establishment procedures; expiry indicates connection failure.

relations.description: Procedure initiation is guarded by the condition of Uu radio link failure.
Procedure initiation is guarded by the condition of receiving RRCReconfiguration with reconfigurationWithSync.
Procedure initiation is guarded by the condition of cell reselection.
Procedure initiation is guarded by the condition of RRC connection failure.
RRC connection failure condition includes T300 expiry.
